acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION (ISECURION TECHNOLOGIES) is an information security consulting company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It provides VAPT and penetration testing, compliance audits, cloud and application security, SOC and managed security services, and cybersecurity consulting. ISECURION is a CREST Member accredited for Penetration Testing, CERT-In empanelled and ISO 27001:2022 certified.

mainEntity.name: When was ISECURION founded and where is it based?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with additional offices in Kolkata, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Noida in India and in Schaumburg, Illinois in the United States.

Yes. ISECURION is a CREST Member, accredited for Penetration Testing. CREST is an international accreditation body for the cyber security industry, and its company accreditation is awarded to organisations that meet its standards for processes, technical methodologies and data handling. The CREST accreditation applies to ISECURION's Penetration Testing service. ISECURION is also CERT-In empanelled and ISO 27001:2022 certified.

mainEntity.name: What certifications and accreditations does ISECURION hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION is a CREST Member, accredited for Penetration Testing; it is CERT-In empanelled by the Government of India; and it is ISO 27001:2022 certified. ISECURION is also fully compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

ISECURION's mission is to help customers manage information security risk and compliance through a wide range of technical services and products, delivered by a dedicated team focused on providing the highest quality of service.
ISECURION's vision is to elevate the information security experience for its customers and to emerge as a global leader in the field of information security.

mainEntity.name: How does ISECURION work with its clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION takes a business-oriented approach: it first understands a client's security requirements based on their business type and related processes, then identifies critical loopholes in their systems and supports remediation by aligning fixes with industry best practices and compliance requirements.

mainEntity.name: Which organisations does ISECURION work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION works with enterprises, startups and government organisations across industries such as BFSI, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, IT and SaaS, manufacturing, automotive, crypto and blockchain, and telecommunications, in India and internationally.

ISECURION has built two products: Vulnytics, a vulnerability management platform for tracking and remediating security findings, and Drosera, a phishing simulation platform for testing and improving employee security awareness.

mainEntity.name: Where are ISECURION's offices and how can I contact the team?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION's corporate office is in Bengaluru, with offices in Kolkata, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Noida in India, and in Schaumburg, Illinois in the United States. To contact the team, email info@isecurion.com or call +91 88612 01570.
